records.jp: コモン内をはびこる魔物、そして現実世界で^00襲い掛かってくる原種から世界を守ることを^00目的として戦う存在
records.en_original: Born to fight the demons of the Common and protect the real world fromt the Sephira threat.
records.en_auxiliary: Born to fight the monsters of the Common and protect the real world from the Sephira threat.
records.en: Born to fight the demons of the Common and protect the real world fromt the Sephira threat.

records.jp: 感情のエネルギーであるエーテルを力にして強力な能力を発動することができる
records.en_original: Able to do incredible things by using emotional energy known as Ether.
records.en_auxiliary: Able to do incredible things by using emotional energy known as Ether.
records.en: Able to do incredible things by using emotional energy known as Ether.

records.jp: また、フラグメントを固定化して装備する^00ことによって、さらにパワーアップすること^00ができる
records.en_original: Additionally, by stabilizing Fragments, they can unlock more power.
records.en_auxiliary: Additionally, by stabilizing Fragments, they can unlock more power.
records.en: Additionally, by stabilizing Fragments, they can unlock more power.

records.jp: 人間の集合的無意識の世界。^00人がそれぞれ持っているコンプレックスの^00さらに奥にある無意識のさらに奥底にある^00共通したベースを具現化した世界
records.en_original: The world of humanity's collective unconscious. Draws its base from the primal depths of the unconscious.
records.en_auxiliary: The world of the human collective unconscious. This is a manifestation of the shared base deep within the unconscious, even farther beyond the insecurities that each person has.
records.en: The world of humanity's collective unconscious. Draws its base from the primal depths of the unconscious.

records.jp: 大きく４つのゾーンに分かれており、^00それぞれ異なる感情が元になってゾーンが^00形成されている
records.en_original: The Common is divided into four Zones, each built off of a different emotion.
records.en_auxiliary: The Common is divided into four zones, each built off of a different emotion.
records.en: The Common is divided into four Zones, each built off of a different emotion.

records.jp: コモンの中に生息し、リフレクターを襲って^00くる敵。それぞれが各感情ゾーンに由来した^00姿を持っている
records.en_original: Beings that inhabit the Common and attack the Reflectors. Each one's form is derived from its respective emotional Zone.
records.en_auxiliary: Beings that inhabit the Common and attack the Reflectors. Each one's form is derived from its respective emotional zone.
records.en: Beings that inhabit the Common and attack the Reflectors. Each one's form is derived from its respective emotional Zone.

records.jp: 突如襲来してきた巨大生物。^00リフレクター同様、エーテルをエネルギー源としている。全て倒すと願いが叶うとされている
records.en_original: Enormous lifeform attacking the real world. Like the Reflectors, they are powered by Ether. Defeating them is said to grant a Reflector one wish.
records.en_auxiliary: Enormous lifeforms attacking the real world. Like the Reflectors, they are powered by Ether. Defeating them is said to grant a Reflector one wish.
records.en: Enormous lifeform attacking the real world. Like the Reflectors, they are powered by Ether. Defeating them is said to grant a Reflector one wish.

records.jp: 強いエーテルエネルギーを放っているため、^00原種が現れると現実でもリフレクターの力を^00使用することが可能となる
records.en_original: Due to the strong amount of Ether emitted by the Sephirot, their presence allows someone to change into a Reflector even in the real world.
records.en_auxiliary: Due to the strong amount of Ether emitted by the Sephira, their presence allows someone to change into a Reflector even in the real world.
records.en: Due to the strong amount of Ether emitted by the Sephirot, their presence allows someone to change into a Reflector even in the real world.

records.jp: 都心より離れた郊外に位置する街。^00駅周辺はそれなりに発展しているが、住宅地^00が多いベッドタウンとしての色が強い
records.en_original: A residential town on the outskirts of a metropolitian area. Even though the area around the station is well-developed, it's known as a commuter town.
records.en_auxiliary: A residential town on the outskirts of a metropolitan area. Even though the area around the station is well-developed, it's known as a commuter town.
records.en: A residential town on the outskirts of a metropolitian area. Even though the area around the station is well-developed, it's known as a commuter town.

records.jp: 日菜子たちが通う女子高校。^00特に芸術系に強い学校であり、その教育にも^00力を入れている。そのため、毎年行われる^00文化祭は全国的にも有名である
records.en_original: Hinako's high school. Known for its focus on the arts and other electives, which has in turn made its culture festival nationally-acclaimed.
records.en_auxiliary: Hinako's high school. Known for its focus on the arts and other electives, which has in turn made its culture festival nationally-acclaimed.
records.en: Hinako's high school. Known for its focus on the arts and other electives, which has in turn made its culture festival nationally-acclaimed.

records.jp: 高校の座標が地球に存在する22の特異点の^00うちの１つであるため、リフレクターの活動^00を行うことができる
records.en_original: The campus built upon one of 22 points of singularity, which is what makes it possible for the Reflectors to work on the campus.
records.en_auxiliary: The campus is built upon one of 22 points of singularity, which is what makes it possible for the Reflectors to work there.
records.en: The campus built upon one of 22 points of singularity, which is what makes it possible for the Reflectors to work on the campus.

records.jp: 現実世界の学校からコモンに行くことを^00「コモンリープ」といい、その略称がリープ
records.en_original: Traveling from the school in the real world to the Common is known as a "Common Leap" but is shortened to simply "Leap."
records.en_auxiliary: Traveling from the school in the real world to the Common is known as a "Common Leap" but is shortened to simply "leap."
records.en: Traveling from the school in the real world to the Common is known as a "Common Leap" but is shortened to simply "Leap."

records.jp: コモンは人間の集合的無意識の世界であり、^00誰を介しても入れるため、あらかじめ目標^00とするフラグメントを狙ってリープするのが^00一般的である
records.en_original: Because the Common is the collective unconscious, people are used as an entryway, allowing one to aim at and Leap toward their specific Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Because the Common is the collective unconscious, people are used as an entryway, allowing one to aim at and Leap toward their specific Fragment.
records.en: Because the Common is the collective unconscious, people are used as an entryway, allowing one to aim at and Leap toward their specific Fragment.

records.jp: 感情のエネルギーの総称。^00リフレクターのエネルギー源であり、^00生物にとっての空気のように、無いと活動が^00できない
records.en_original: A simple term for emotional energy. As essential for a Reflector as the air they breathe.
records.en_auxiliary: A simple term for emotional energy. As essential for a Reflector as the air they breathe.
records.en: A simple term for emotional energy. As essential for a Reflector as the air they breathe.

records.jp: リフレクターとしての能力全般の総称。^00正式名称はエーテルスキル
records.en_original: Generic term for a Reflector's ability. Officially called an "Ether Skill."
records.en_auxiliary: The generic term for a Reflector's ability. Officially called an "Ether Skill."
records.en: Generic term for a Reflector's ability. Officially called an "Ether Skill."

records.jp: 正式名称はエーテルフラグメント。^00人の強い感情によってできる“想いの欠片”^00である
records.en_original: Officially called an "Ether Fragment." A piece of feeling formed by a person's powerful emotions.
records.en_auxiliary: Officially called an "Ether Fragment." A piece of feeling formed by a person's powerful emotions.
records.en: Officially called an "Ether Fragment." A piece of feeling formed by a person's powerful emotions.

records.jp: 通常、人の感情はすぐ変わるため、コモン内^00で出たり消えたりを繰り返しており、ずっと^00存在し続けることは稀である
records.en_original: As human emotions chage frequently, Fragments usually rapidly appear and disappear in the common. It's rare for one to stay in place for long.
records.en_auxiliary: As human emotions change frequently, Fragments usually rapidly appear and disappear in the Common. It's rare for one to stay in place for long.
records.en: As human emotions chage frequently, Fragments usually rapidly appear and disappear in the common. It's rare for one to stay in place for long.

records.jp: 感情が膨れ上がり制御できなくなり、自我を失ってしまった状態。特異点である学校では感情エネルギーが一定以上になると暴走してしまう
records.en_original: A state in which one's emotions are so overwhelming that they lose themselves. Rampancy ensues more regularly at the school because it's on a singularity.
records.en_auxiliary: A state in which one's emotions are so overwhelming that they lose themselves. Rampancy ensues more regularly at the school because it's on a singularity.
records.en: A state in which one's emotions are so overwhelming that they lose themselves. Rampancy ensues more regularly at the school because it's on a singularity.

records.jp: 暴走したフラグメントは強いエネルギーを有しているためすぐに消えない。それが原因でその間に魔物に襲われやすく、それによりさらに暴走してしまう危険がある
records.en_original: Rampant Fragments have such strong energy that they do not disappear. This draws demons to them, which attack and further degenerate the Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Rampant Fragments have such strong energy that they do not disappear. This draws monsters to them, which attack and further degenerate the Fragment.
records.en: Rampant Fragments have such strong energy that they do not disappear. This draws demons to them, which attack and further degenerate the Fragment.

records.jp: フラグメントが傷つけられると精神も傷つけられる。あくまで欠片であるため、１つ壊された程度では問題ないが、いくつも壊されると精神が壊れ、死に至る可能性もある
records.en_original: Damaged Fragments damage the psyche. Losing one isn't too problematic, but losing too many can lead to a mental breakdown or even death.
records.en_auxiliary: Damaged Fragments damage the psyche. Losing one isn't too problematic, but losing too many can lead to a mental breakdown or even death.
records.en: Damaged Fragments damage the psyche. Losing one isn't too problematic, but losing too many can lead to a mental breakdown or even death.

records.jp: 日菜子が持つリフレクターとしての能力。^00フラグメントに付随した感情を理解すること^00で、そのフラグメントを固定化し、装着する^00ことができる
records.en_original: One of the abilities Hinako has as a Reflector. Understanding the feeling linked to a Fragment allows her to stabilize and equip it.
records.en_auxiliary: One of the abilities Hinako has as a Reflector. Understanding the feeling linked to a Fragment allows her to stabilize and equip it.
records.en: One of the abilities Hinako has as a Reflector. Understanding the feeling linked to a Fragment allows her to stabilize and equip it.

records.jp: また、フラグメントを固定化してできた繋が^00りを指輪で強化することにより、指輪をした^00仲間も戦闘能力を得ることができる
records.en_original: You can also strengthen your rings with the bond created by the stabilization of a Fragment, granting friends with rings to become more combat-capable.
records.en_auxiliary: You can also strengthen your rings with the bond created by stabilizing a Fragment, allowing friends with rings to become more combat-capable.
records.en: You can also strengthen your rings with the bond created by the stabilization of a Fragment, granting friends with rings to become more combat-capable.

records.jp: 日本中で普及している、パーソナル空間が^00容易に作成できるサービス。アカウントを作成すれば、自分の端末に導入する事が出来る
records.en_original: A popular service in Japan that allows a user to make a virtual personal space. Once you create an account, you can install it on your device of choice.
records.en_auxiliary: A popular service in Japan that allows a user to make a virtual personal space. Once you create an account, you can install it on your device of choice.
records.en: A popular service in Japan that allows a user to make a virtual personal space. Once you create an account, you can install it on your device of choice.

records.jp: 略さない名称は「フリースペース！」。^00その名のとおり、インターネット上に、自分の好きな空間を作成できる自由さを追求している
records.en_original: As the name suggests, this service provides users a space on the internet that they're free to customize to their heart's content.
records.en_auxiliary: As the name suggests, this service provides users a space on the internet that they're free to customize to their heart's content.
records.en: As the name suggests, this service provides users a space on the internet that they're free to customize to their heart's content.

records.jp: 広大なコモンの内奥に聳え立つ塔で、コモンの中枢機関でもある。それぞれのゾーンから感情のエネルギーが脈々とここへ集まって^00くる
records.en_original: A lone tower that resides in the center of the massive space that is the Common. Veins of emotional energy from the other  Zones flow into this central area.
records.en_auxiliary: A lone tower that lies in the center of the vast Common. Veins of emotional energy from the other zones flow into this central area.
records.en: A lone tower that resides in the center of the massive space that is the Common. Veins of emotional energy from the other  Zones flow into this central area.

records.jp: 人の喜びにまつわる感情が基調のゾーン。^00容認されたいという想いや、安寧の享受、^00大切な人との信頼、愛情……など
records.en_original: Joyful emotions are the heart of this Zone. The desire for approval, the calm of peace, the trust of one's loved ones, and affection, for example.
records.en_auxiliary: Joyful emotions are the heart of this zone. The desire for approval, the calm of peace, the trust of one's loved ones, and affection, for example.
records.en: Joyful emotions are the heart of this Zone. The desire for approval, the calm of peace, the trust of one's loved ones, and affection, for example.

records.jp: 喜びのゾーンにあるフラグメントが侵されると、歓喜する感情も常軌を逸したものとなってしまい、激しい恍惚や混乱の状態に陥ることもある
records.en_original: When Fragments in the Happiness Zone are compromised, feelings of delight become erratic, sometimes falling into a state of intense ecstasy or confusion.
records.en_auxiliary: When Fragments in the Happiness Zone are compromised, feelings of delight become erratic, sometimes falling into a state of intense ecstasy or confusion.
records.en: When Fragments in the Happiness Zone are compromised, feelings of delight become erratic, sometimes falling into a state of intense ecstasy or confusion.

records.jp: 人の恐怖にまつわる感情が基調のゾーン。^00先が見通せない不安感や、安息を得られない^00焦燥感、おののくほどの畏れ……など
records.en_original: Fearful emotions are the base of this Zone. Uncertainty, the frustration that comes from not being able to rest, and raw terror, for example.
records.en_auxiliary: Fearful emotions are the base of this zone. Uncertainty, the frustration that comes from not being able to rest, and raw terror, for example.
records.en: Fearful emotions are the base of this Zone. Uncertainty, the frustration that comes from not being able to rest, and raw terror, for example.

records.jp: 恐怖のゾーンにあるフラグメントが侵されると、未来が途絶したような、得体の知れない何かに襲われているような、尋常ではない絶望感に苦しめられることもある
records.en_original: When Fragments in the Fear Zone are compromised, one may feel that they have no future, that they're crushed under despair, or under attack by the unknown.
records.en_auxiliary: When Fragments in the Fear Zone are compromised, one may feel that they have no future, that they're crushed under despair, or under attack by the unknown.
records.en: When Fragments in the Fear Zone are compromised, one may feel that they have no future, that they're crushed under despair, or under attack by the unknown.

records.jp: 人の悲しみにまつわる感情が基調のゾーン。^00抑えようのない憎しみ、止めどなく溢れる^00感傷、そして自責の念……など
records.en_original: Sorrowful emotions are the soul of this Zone. Unsatisfiable grudges, overflowing sentiment, and feelings of remorse, for example.
records.en_auxiliary: Sorrowful emotions are the soul of this zone. Irrepressible grudges, overflowing sentimentality, and feelings of remorse, for example.
records.en: Sorrowful emotions are the soul of this Zone. Unsatisfiable grudges, overflowing sentiment, and feelings of remorse, for example.

records.jp: 悲しみのゾーンにあるフラグメントが侵されると、些細なことへの嫌悪感も増長し、意思も薄弱となってしまうほどの倦怠感に苛まれることもある
records.en_original: When Fragments in the Sorrow Zone are compromised, minor things become grave offenses and intent is swallowed by fatigue.
records.en_auxiliary: When Fragments in the Sorrow Zone are compromised, minor things become grave offenses and intent is swallowed by fatigue.
records.en: When Fragments in the Sorrow Zone are compromised, minor things become grave offenses and intent is swallowed by fatigue.

records.jp: 人の怒りにまつわる感情が基調のゾーン。^00警戒心や苛立ち、やり場のない烈情、自らが損なわれたときの、許せない気持ち……など
records.en_original: Wrathful emotions are the core of this Zone.  Wariness and irritaion, anger without purpose, self-loathing, and a lack of forgiveness, for example.
records.en_auxiliary: Wrathful emotions are the core of this zone. Wariness and irritation, anger without purpose, self-loathing, and a lack of forgiveness, for example.
records.en: Wrathful emotions are the core of this Zone.  Wariness and irritaion, anger without purpose, self-loathing, and a lack of forgiveness, for example.

records.jp: 怒りのゾーンにあるフラグメントが侵されると、烈火のごとく激怒が沸き起こる。罵詈雑言を吐き散らし、抑えきれない破壊衝動に襲われることもある
records.en_original: When Fragments in the Anger Zone are compromised, people are engulfed by rage. They spit abusive language and are overwhelmed by destructive impulses.
records.en_auxiliary: When Fragments in the Anger Zone are compromised, people are engulfed by rage. They spit abusive language and are overwhelmed by destructive impulses.
records.en: When Fragments in the Anger Zone are compromised, people are engulfed by rage. They spit abusive language and are overwhelmed by destructive impulses.

records.jp: 喜びのゾーンと、隣り合う恐怖のゾーンが混合し、時おり発生するゾーン
records.en_original: A rarely occuring Zone that melds the Happiness Zone and Fear Zone.
records.en_auxiliary: A rarely occurring zone that melds the Happiness Zone and Fear Zone.
records.en: A rarely occuring Zone that melds the Happiness Zone and Fear Zone.

records.jp: 喜びと恐怖のゾーンでフラグメントが侵されると、喜びや嬉しさを自ら抑制してしまうかのように後ろめたさや懸念も生じ、歯止めのきかない不安定な状態になることもある
records.en_original: When Fragments in the Happiness and Fear Zone are compromised, guilt and anxiety surface from a desire to hide one's feelings of joy, making one unstable.
records.en_auxiliary: When Fragments in the Happiness and Fear Zone are compromised, guilt and anxiety surface from a desire to hide one's feelings of joy, making one unstable.
records.en: When Fragments in the Happiness and Fear Zone are compromised, guilt and anxiety surface from a desire to hide one's feelings of joy, making one unstable.

records.jp: 恐怖のゾーンと、隣り合う悲しみのゾーンが混合し、時おり発生するゾーン
records.en_original: A rarely occuring Zone that melds the Fear Zone and Sorrow Zone.
records.en_auxiliary: A rarely occurring zone that melds the Fear Zone and Sorrow Zone.
records.en: A rarely occuring Zone that melds the Fear Zone and Sorrow Zone.

records.jp: 恐怖と悲しみのゾーンでフラグメントが侵されると、恐怖に怯えるのに加え悲嘆や感傷にも侵され、失意に苛まれ激しく動揺することもある
records.en_original: When Fragments in the Fear and Sorrow Zone are compromised, the grief and regret can engulf and violently shake the person going rampant.
records.en_auxiliary: When Fragments in the Fear and Sorrow Zone are compromised, the grief and regret can engulf and violently shake the person going rampant.
records.en: When Fragments in the Fear and Sorrow Zone are compromised, the grief and regret can engulf and violently shake the person going rampant.

records.jp: 悲しみのゾーンと、隣り合う怒りのゾーンが混合し、時おり発生するゾーン
records.en_original: A rarely occuring Zone that melds the Sorrow Zone and Anger Zone.
records.en_auxiliary: A rarely occurring zone that melds the Sorrow Zone and Anger Zone.
records.en: A rarely occuring Zone that melds the Sorrow Zone and Anger Zone.

records.jp: 悲しみと怒りのゾーンでフラグメントが侵されると、悲しみに苦悶するばかりでなく、自分が陥っている悲惨な状況に対する怒りの感情にも目覚めることがある
records.en_original: When Fragments in the Sorrow and Anger Zone are compromised, tragedy is not met just with sadness, but anger over the miserable situation.
records.en_auxiliary: When Fragments in the Sorrow and Anger Zone are compromised, tragedy is met not just with sadness, but anger over the miserable situation.
records.en: When Fragments in the Sorrow and Anger Zone are compromised, tragedy is not met just with sadness, but anger over the miserable situation.

records.jp: 怒りのゾーンと、隣り合う喜びのゾーンが混合し、時おり発生するゾーン
records.en_original: A rarely occuring Zone that melds the Anger Zone and Happiness Zone.
records.en_auxiliary: A rarely occurring zone that melds the Anger Zone and Happiness Zone.
records.en: A rarely occuring Zone that melds the Anger Zone and Happiness Zone.

records.jp: 怒りと喜びのゾーンでフラグメントが侵されると、赦しがたいほどの怒りに震える傍ら、怒りを表出することへの快感を覚え、恍惚とした気持ちすら芽生えることもある
records.en_original: When Fragments in the Anger and Happiness Zone are compromised, expressing rage becomes pleasant, even ecstatic.
records.en_auxiliary: When Fragments in the Anger and Happiness Zone are compromised, expressing rage becomes pleasant, even ecstatic.
records.en: When Fragments in the Anger and Happiness Zone are compromised, expressing rage becomes pleasant, even ecstatic.

records.jp: 星ノ宮に唯一ある、私鉄が通る駅。快速に乗れば40分ほど、各駅停車では１時間弱で都心まで出られる。下りに乗り続ければ、小一時間で山々が連なる県境の方へと出られる
records.en_original: The only station in Hoshinomiya. The city is 40 minutes away on the express, or an hour otherwise. The other way leads to a mountain at prefecture's end.
records.en_auxiliary: The only station in Hoshinomiya. The city is 40 minutes away on the express, or an hour otherwise. The other way leads to the mountains at the edge of the prefecture.
records.en: The only station in Hoshinomiya. The city is 40 minutes away on the express, or an hour otherwise. The other way leads to a mountain at prefecture's end.

records.jp: 星ノ宮は主として住宅地の街だが、星ノ宮駅には「通勤特急」も停車する。星ノ宮女子高校が有名校として名を馳せるようになったことの恩恵だと考えられている
records.en_original: Hoshinomiya is mostly a residential district, but the station is a stop for a "Commuter Express," possibly due to Hoshinomiya Girls' High School's renown.
records.en_auxiliary: Though Hoshinomiya is mostly a residential<CR>district, its station is also a stop for the express<CR>train, possibly due to the renown of Hoshinomiya Girls' High School.
records.en: Hoshinomiya is mostly a residential district, but the station is a stop for a "Commuter Express," possibly due to Hoshinomiya Girls' High School's renown.

records.jp: 緑の公園の中にぽつんとある、小さな古墳。^00時には家出した子供の隠れ家だったり、仕事帰りの大人がのら猫と待ち合わせる場所だったりと様々な顔を見せる
records.en_original: A small tomb in a verdant park. Known as a haven for runaway children, a meeting place for adults getting off work, and a stray cat's paradise.
records.en_auxiliary: A small tomb in a verdant park. Known as a haven for runaway children, a meeting place for adults getting off work, and a stray cat's paradise.
records.en: A small tomb in a verdant park. Known as a haven for runaway children, a meeting place for adults getting off work, and a stray cat's paradise.

records.jp: いつの頃から存在しているのか、どのような人物の墓なのか、あるいは墓ではなく戦時中の基地だったのか、人によって語られる逸話がさまざまある
records.en_original: Many rumors have been spread about the age of the tomb, who it belongs to, or whether it was used as a base instead of a tomb during times of war.
records.en_auxiliary: Many rumors have been spread about the age of the tomb, who it belongs to, or whether it was used as a base instead of a tomb during times of war.
records.en: Many rumors have been spread about the age of the tomb, who it belongs to, or whether it was used as a base instead of a tomb during times of war.

records.jp: 住宅地から離れた竹林の中に、静かに佇んでいる神社。江戸時代の初期から現在の場所にあると言い伝えられている
records.en_original: A peaceful shrine in a bamboo forest on the outskirts of the residential area. It's said to have stood since the start of the Edo period.
records.en_auxiliary: A peaceful shrine in a bamboo forest on the outskirts of the residential area. It's said to have stood since the start of the Edo period.
records.en: A peaceful shrine in a bamboo forest on the outskirts of the residential area. It's said to have stood since the start of the Edo period.

records.jp: 初詣や七五三など一年を通して豊かな行事に恵まれている。特に夏の七夕祭りは多くの地元の人で賑わう。本殿の後ろにある竹林に、思い思いの短冊を飾る慣習もある
records.en_original: Bustles with events throughout the year, The Star Festival draws an especially large number of locals. Many adorn the  bamboo forest with their paper wishes.
records.en_auxiliary: Bustles with events throughout the year. The Star Festival draws an especially large number of locals. Many adorn the bamboo forest with their paper wishes.
records.en: Bustles with events throughout the year, The Star Festival draws an especially large number of locals. Many adorn the  bamboo forest with their paper wishes.

records.jp: 星ノ宮に長く息づいている、木造の映画館。^00歴史があまりに長く、いつの頃からか「日本最古級」の映画館と称されるまでになった
records.en_original: A wooden movie theater that has operated in Hoshinomiya for generations. It earned the title of "Japan's Oldest Movie Theater" some time ago.
records.en_auxiliary: A wooden movie theater that has operated in Hoshinomiya for generations. It earned the title of "Japan's Oldest Movie Theater" some time ago.
records.en: A wooden movie theater that has operated in Hoshinomiya for generations. It earned the title of "Japan's Oldest Movie Theater" some time ago.

records.jp: 配給物も単館系も、幅広いジャンルの映画を上映する。上映内容は短期間で変わるため、足しげく通う熱心なファンも多く、彼らに営業を支えられている
records.en_original: Shows everything from worldwide films to arthouse movies of all genres. The lineup changes regularly for the zealous fans keeping them in business.
records.en_auxiliary: Shows everything from worldwide films to arthouse movies of all genres. The lineup changes regularly for the zealous fans keeping them in business.
records.en: Shows everything from worldwide films to arthouse movies of all genres. The lineup changes regularly for the zealous fans keeping them in business.

records.jp: 音楽や美術、スポーツなど、秀でた才能や実績を持つ生徒が所属するクラス。２年生後半にもなると各々の専門性が一層磨かれ、もともと豊かな個性がさらに開花していく
records.en_original: A special course consisting of students who excel  in music, fine arts, or sports. Halfway through the second year, the curriculum focuses even further.
records.en_auxiliary: A special class consisting of students who excel in music, fine arts, or sports. Halfway through the second year, the curriculum focuses on each student's expertise to further develop their individuality.
records.en: A special course consisting of students who excel  in music, fine arts, or sports. Halfway through the second year, the curriculum focuses even further.

records.jp: 一般的な教養を積みたい、という生徒が所属するクラス。多くの生徒は、大学進学を目指し、基本の五教科も実技教科もバランスよく勉強する
records.en_original: The standard college-prep curriculum at Hoshinomiya. Students take a balance of both general education and elective courses.
records.en_auxiliary: The standard school curriculum at Hoshinomiya. Students take a balance of both general education and elective courses aiming for college-prep.
records.en: The standard college-prep curriculum at Hoshinomiya. Students take a balance of both general education and elective courses.

records.jp: 星ノ宮女子高校の名物行事。それぞれの学年の普通科と特待科が協同し、一つの出し物を披露するのが毎年の恒例になっている
records.en_original: Hoshinomiya Girls' High School's signature event, held every year. Both normal and special classes work together on a performance or other event.
records.en_auxiliary: Hoshinomiya Girls' High School's annual signature event. Both normal and special classes work together on a performance or other attraction.
records.en: Hoshinomiya Girls' High School's signature event, held every year. Both normal and special classes work together on a performance or other event.

records.jp: 雑誌やテレビの取材も駆けつけるほど都内では名が知れている。有名アスリートのコーチや、劇団、声優養成所の監督なども見学に足を運ぶため、スカウトを受ける生徒もいる
records.en_original: Esteemed enough for TV and magazine coverage, the festival draws headhunters such as famous coaches, theatrical companies, and voiceover directors.
records.en_auxiliary: Esteemed enough for TV and magazine coverage, the festival draws headhunters such as famous coaches, theatrical companies, and voiceover directors.
records.en: Esteemed enough for TV and magazine coverage, the festival draws headhunters such as famous coaches, theatrical companies, and voiceover directors.

records.jp: 内実は立ち入り禁止の場所とされている。^00だが、この屋上ほど、星ノ宮の家々や遠くの山並みを一望できるところは実はなかなか無いと言われる
records.en_original: While technically off-limits to students, the rooftop is one of the few places that offers an aerial view of Hoshinomiya and a look at the mountains.
records.en_auxiliary: While technically off-limits to students, the rooftop is one of the few places that offers an aerial view of Hoshinomiya and a look at the mountains.
records.en: While technically off-limits to students, the rooftop is one of the few places that offers an aerial view of Hoshinomiya and a look at the mountains.

records.jp: パンやジュース、文房具を取り揃えている。^00すぐ隣には、自動販売機コーナーと、ちょっとした広さのホールがある
records.en_original: A store that sells drinks, bread, and stationary. A decent-sized hall with a vending machine is just outside.
records.en_auxiliary: A store that sells drinks, bread, and stationery. A decent-sized hall with a vending machine is just outside.
records.en: A store that sells drinks, bread, and stationary. A decent-sized hall with a vending machine is just outside.

records.jp: １年生の教室がある階にあるため、２、３年生に上がると足が遠のいてしまう人も
records.en_original: Because it's located on the same floor as the first year classrooms, second and third year students tend to visit less often.
records.en_auxiliary: Because it's located on the same floor as the first-year classrooms, second- and third-year students tend to visit less often.
records.en: Because it's located on the same floor as the first year classrooms, second and third year students tend to visit less often.

records.jp: もともとは空き教室。日替わりで有志の同好会や、こじんまりとした文化部が会合を開くための部屋として有意義に活用されている。基本はオープンで、自由に見学ができる
records.en_original: Normally a vacant, open room. Depending on the day, the festival committee or another group will likely be using it for a meeting.
records.en_auxiliary: Normally a vacant, open room. Depending on the day, the festival committee or another group will likely be using it for a meeting.
records.en: Normally a vacant, open room. Depending on the day, the festival committee or another group will likely be using it for a meeting.

records.jp: フリスぺ！に内包される、一つ一つのコンテンツのこと。公式のチャンネル、企業が公開するチャンネル、個人が自由かつ簡単に作成出来るチャンネルなどさまざまある
records.en_original: Channels are modular content used with FreeSpace! There are all sorts of channels, some official company-run creations, and others user-customized.
records.en_auxiliary: Channels are modular content used with FreeSpace! There are all sorts of channels, some official company-run creations, and others user-customized.
records.en: Channels are modular content used with FreeSpace! There are all sorts of channels, some official company-run creations, and others user-customized.

records.jp: フリスぺ！の壁紙のデザインのこと。いつも目にする画面を、ユーザーそれぞれが好みの見た目に着せ替えできるようになっている
records.en_original: Allows users to customize the wallpaper and theme of their FreeSpace page.
records.en_auxiliary: Allows users to customize the wallpaper and theme of their FreeSpace! page.
records.en: Allows users to customize the wallpaper and theme of their FreeSpace page.

records.jp: 個人が営む雑貨屋。長く店を続けてきた歴史もありながら、流行りの面白くて高機能な文房具や、若い女の子が好む可愛い雑貨など、折々で商品がアップデートされる
records.en_original: A long-standing, privately owned general store. The owners regularly update their stock of stylish, fun stationary, and cute products for girls.
records.en_auxiliary: A long-standing, privately owned general store. The owners regularly update their stock of stylish, fun stationery, and cute products for girls.
records.en: A long-standing, privately owned general store. The owners regularly update their stock of stylish, fun stationary, and cute products for girls.

records.jp: 住宅地の中に佇むお洒落なお店、というように、その素敵な雰囲気については地域に暮らす人皆から一目置かれている
records.en_original: A trendy store in the middle of a residential district, the store's distinctive air pleases the locals.
records.en_auxiliary: Located in the middle of a residential district, the trendy store's distinctive air pleases the locals.
records.en: A trendy store in the middle of a residential district, the store's distinctive air pleases the locals.

records.jp: 一年を通して室温や湿度が整えられている保健室。冷蔵庫には朝食を食べ損ねた人のためのお菓子が入っていたり、洗い場にはコンタクトの洗浄液が置いてあったりなど福利満載
records.en_original: An infirmary kept at the same humidity and temperature year round. Stocked for any situation, from missing breakfasts to dry contacts.
records.en_auxiliary: An infirmary kept at the same humidity and temperature year-round. Stocked for any situation, from missing breakfasts to dry contacts.
records.en: An infirmary kept at the same humidity and temperature year round. Stocked for any situation, from missing breakfasts to dry contacts.

records.jp: ベッドの布団は見かけによらず、ぐっすり眠れると評判。保健委員は、本当に体調不良の人のベッドが不足しないよう、休みに来た学生が仮病かどうかジャッジしているという
records.en_original: Despite the futon's appearance, it's renowned as the best nap spot on campus. The nurse often drives away students who fake illness to get to rest on this bed.
records.en_auxiliary: Despite the futon's appearance, it's renowned as the best nap spot on campus. The nurse often drives away students who fake illness to get to rest on this bed.
records.en: Despite the futon's appearance, it's renowned as the best nap spot on campus. The nurse often drives away students who fake illness to get to rest on this bed.

records.jp: いつでも整理整頓と清掃が行き届いている図書室。学生のお小遣いでは手が届かないような大判のマンガや、初級から上級までの美術資料集や楽譜といった蔵書も豊富にある
records.en_original: An expertly-maintained library full of expensive books ranging from large-format manga to art and music reference books.
records.en_auxiliary: An expertly maintained library full of expensive books ranging from large-format manga to art and music reference books.
records.en: An expertly-maintained library full of expensive books ranging from large-format manga to art and music reference books.

records.jp: 放送部員が活動する場所。高額でデリケートな機材に囲まれているため、放送部員以外は基本的に立ち入りを遠慮するように、と注意喚起されている
records.en_original: Where the broadcasting club members do their broadcasting. Due to the delicate and expensive equipment, non-members are asked not to enter the room.
records.en_auxiliary: Where the broadcasting club members do their broadcasting. To protect their delicate and expensive equipment, non-members are asked not to enter the room.
records.en: Where the broadcasting club members do their broadcasting. Due to the delicate and expensive equipment, non-members are asked not to enter the room.

records.jp: 放送部員が脚本の執筆に集中できるようにと^00放送室の隣に設えられた教室。各所のコンクールに応募することも目標に据え、日々執筆に励んでいる
records.en_original: A room next to the broadcasting room specifically designated for writing scripts. The writers work daily and try to enter various writing competitions.
records.en_auxiliary: A room next to the broadcasting room specifically designated for writing scripts. The writers work daily and try to enter various writing competitions.
records.en: A room next to the broadcasting room specifically designated for writing scripts. The writers work daily and try to enter various writing competitions.

records.jp: 少人数体制の生徒会が活動する教室。仕事の量が多いからか、雑多な雰囲気が気にならないのか、星ノ宮女子高校で一番と言って良いほど整理整頓がなっていないという
records.en_original: A classroom in which the small student council group holds their meetings. It may be the messiest room in the school, but that doesn't seem to bother them.
records.en_auxiliary: A classroom in which the small student council group holds their meetings. It may be the messiest room in the school, but that doesn't seem to bother them.
records.en: A classroom in which the small student council group holds their meetings. It may be the messiest room in the school, but that doesn't seem to bother them.

records.jp: ほとんどの学生は知らないが、教室の片隅にサメの頭部のオブジェがある。卒業生の寄贈品なのか、特待科の学生が自作して置いたのか、いつからあるのかもよく分かっていない
records.en_original: Unbeknownst to most students, there is a shark head object in the corner of the room. Nobody knows where it came from or how long it's been there, though...
records.en_auxiliary: Unbeknownst to most students, there is a shark head object in the corner of the room. Nobody knows where it came from or how long it's been there, though...
records.en: Unbeknownst to most students, there is a shark head object in the corner of the room. Nobody knows where it came from or how long it's been there, though...

records.jp: 家族や友達と短いメッセージを交換する時に活躍するチャンネル。文章がうまく浮かばない時や、もっと手短に気持ちを伝えたい時には、スタンプも活用できる
records.en_original: A channel useful for sending messages to friends and family. Stickers are often sent for quick communication or when words can't quite convey a response.
records.en_auxiliary: A channel useful for sending messages to friends and family. Stickers are often sent for quick communication or when words can't quite convey a response.
records.en: A channel useful for sending messages to friends and family. Stickers are often sent for quick communication or when words can't quite convey a response.

records.jp: 当初は１０～２０代の若い人がメインのユーザーという想定だったが、使い方が分かりやすいことから、リリースされてすぐに老若男女問わず使われるようになった
records.en_original: While the intended userbase were girls ages 10 to<CR>20, the accessible interface has made it popular with people of all ages and genders.
records.en_auxiliary: While the intended userbase was girls ages 10 to 20, the accessible interface has made it popular with people of all ages and genders.
records.en: While the intended userbase were girls ages 10 to<CR>20, the accessible interface has made it popular with people of all ages and genders.

records.jp: フリスぺ！に最初から入っている、魔物を育成するミニゲーム。魔物の形態がどのように変化していくかは、ユーザーの手に委ねられている
records.en_original: A monster raising game that is preinstalled on FreeSpace! It tasks the user with raising transforming monsters.
records.en_auxiliary: A monster-raising game that is preinstalled on FreeSpace! It tasks the user with raising transforming monsters.
records.en: A monster raising game that is preinstalled on FreeSpace! It tasks the user with raising transforming monsters.

records.jp: 魔物の行動パターンや、成長していく過程から、ユーザーのその時々の心情も伺い知れるのかもしれない
records.en_original: The way that a monster acts and grows may depend on the user's current mental state...
records.en_auxiliary: The way that a monster acts and grows may depend on the user's current mental state...
records.en: The way that a monster acts and grows may depend on the user's current mental state...

records.jp: 音楽を手軽に再生できるチャンネル。ネーミングに関しては、ある種、このチャンネルの開発者の昔への憧憬が表れている
records.en_original: A channel allowing for easy music playback. The naming is a nod to its creator's nostalgia for the past.
records.en_auxiliary: A channel allowing for easy music playback. The naming is a nod to its creator's nostalgia for the past.
records.en: A channel allowing for easy music playback. The naming is a nod to its creator's nostalgia for the past.
